ov: الغبي والأغبى (الإنجليزية: Dumb and Dumber) فيلم كوميدي من بطولة جيم كاري وجيف دانييلز أنتج عام 1994 وقصته عن شخصين هما لويد وهاري (كاري ودانيالز) يسافران براً لإرجاع حقيبة لامرأة قد نسيتها في المطار في نفس الوقت الذي تطاردهما فيه عصابة لاستعادة حقيبة النقود منهما. وفي عام 1995 صدر عن الفيلم مسلسل كرتوني يحمل نفس العنوان.
plotEn:
Lloyd Christmas and Harry Dunne are two good-hearted but dimwitted best friends and roommates living in Providence, Rhode Island. Lloyd, a chip-toothed limousine driver, is instantly smitten with his passenger Mary Swanson, who is flying to Aspen, Colorado. She leaves a briefcase in the airport and Lloyd attempts to return it, unaware it contains ransom money she has left for criminals Joe "Mental" Mentalino and J. P. Shay. Mary's plane has already departed, and Lloyd falls out of the jetway.
Fired for leaving the scene of an accident, Lloyd returns home to learn that Harry, a dog groomer, has also been fired for showing up late to a dog show with the dogs covered in food. Mental and Shay follow Lloyd home, but he and Harry mistake the crooks for debt collectors and flee, returning later to find Harry's parakeet has been decapitated by Mental who intended it as a threat, but Harry mistakenly believes the bird's head fell off due to old age. Lloyd convinces Harry that they should return Mary's briefcase, and they set off for Aspen in Harry's dog-styled van.
Mental poses as a hitchhiker and is picked up by Harry and Lloyd, who annoy him with their childish antics. Stopping for lunch, Mental plans to slip the duo rat poison pills, but they prank him by putting chili peppers in his burger, aggravating his stomach ulcer. Mistaking the pills for his medication, they inadvertently kill him with the poison but continue their trip.
